:::{#def-sigma-finite}
#### Finite and $\sigma$-finite measures

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space).
The measure $\measure$ is **finite** if $\measure(S) < \infty$.
It is **$\sigma$-finite** if $S$ is the union $\bigcup_{i=1}^{\infty} A_i$
of a sequence of sets $A_1, A_2, \ldots$ in $\salg$
with $\measure(A_i) < \infty$ for every $i$.

:::
